name: focus-group
description: Plan and run an editable multi-model persona panel that tests a product and returns synthetic findings and a build/fix backlog.
short_description: Multi-model persona panels for product research
argument_hint: plan <product-or-brief> | plan <study> | run <study> | resume <study> | status <study> | cancel <study> | doctor

workers.responsibility: Act as one invented persona on approved product material. Report reactions, observations and inferences separately without seeing other cells.
Synthesise only accepted participant evidence into cited findings, dissent and a prioritised backlog. Never invent quotes or demand.
Check the exact report against its pinned accepted inputs for faithful quotes, support counts and preserved dissent.
Challenge the exact study protocol, matrix, authority, budget and recovery plan before dependent panel work. Preserve the separate stronger fidelity review.

plan.reason: Review the exact editable persona/model protocol and authority/budget revision before owner approval or any panel work.

run.reason: Consume the current study-plan receipt before panel work. Final synthesis uses the existing stricter fidelity review of the exact bundle, accepted inputs, citations, dissent, coverage and distinct author lineage; no duplicate planning pass over that same report.

resume.reason: Retain pinned matrix/analyst/fidelity targets and options. Reuse unchanged accepted study-plan and fidelity evidence; changed study revisions need new planning review and owner approval. Reconcile owned children without budget reset.

status.reason: Read-only study and owned-task state inspection has no synthesis or dispatch.

cancel.reason: Deterministic cancellation intent and reconciliation concern only owned tasks, with no synthesis.

doctor.reason: Local package/catalog/schema readiness has no substantive planning or synthesis.
